name: Rib Eye Steak with Sautéed Mixed Vegetables

instructions.primary_message: Wash green beans, carrot, and bell pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
227 g green beans
1 medium carrot
1 red bell pepper

instructions.primary_message: Trim green bean ends and transfer to a large bowl. Seed and slice pepper into strips lengthwise; add to bowl. Trim ends, peel, and thinly slice carrot on the diagonal; add to bowl.
Heat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or skillet over medium-high heat.
Season steak with salt and pepper on both sides.
instructions.secondary_message:
340 g ribeye steak
salt
black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Coat grill or skillet with oil. Add steak and cook until desired doneness, 2-5 minutes per side. Transfer to a plate and loosely cover with foil.
Heat a separate skillet over medium heat.
Melt oil in skillet and add garlic; cook until fragrant, 15-30 seconds. Add vegetables and cook, stirring often, until tender-crisp, 5-6 minutes. Season with salt and pepper; toss to coat.
instructions.secondary_message:
virgin coconut oil
salt
black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Serve steak with sautéed vegetables on the side. Enjoy!
